responsibility: This file implements GCC’s RTL mode-switching optimization for targets that require explicit machine-mode state changes, such as floating-point or execution-mode entities. It scans insns to build per-entity per-basic-block mode segments and live-register information, formulates mode placement as a lazy code motion problem over CFG edges using lcm.c, and then emits targetm.mode_switching state-change insns at optimal edges or within blocks. Its responsibility is minimizing explicit processor mode transitions while preserving required execution modes, distinct from ordinary instruction scheduling or register allocation.
